support.title: Help & contact
support.description: Answers to common questions about SPICY NIGHT and how to reach us.
support.contactText: A question, a bug or a card that doesn’t fit? Write to us – ideally with your device, operating system and app version (in the app under **Settings → About SPICY NIGHT**).

faq.q: Are there purchases or ads in the app?
faq.a: No. The current version has neither in-app purchases nor ads – all game modes and cards are included.

faq.q: Do I need an account or internet?
faq.a: No. SPICY NIGHT works without an account and fully offline. You play on one device that is passed around the group.
2 to 20. “Who’s Most Likely?” needs at least 3 people.

faq.q: Do you have to drink alcohol?
faq.a: No, no card asks for alcohol. “I pass” is always allowed, tasks involving touch only happen with a clear yes, and EXTREME only starts once the whole group agrees.

faq.q: What data does the app store?
faq.a: Only on your device: player names, your own cards, the current game and your settings. Answers are never stored, and nothing is transmitted to us or third parties. More in the [privacy policy](../privacy/).

faq.q: How do I delete all data?
faq.a: In the app under **Settings → Data → Delete all local data**. Uninstalling the app removes it as well.

faq.q: How do I change the language?
faq.a: SPICY NIGHT starts in your device’s language (German, English or Spanish). You can switch at any time under **Settings → Language** – even in the middle of a game.

faq.q: Can I share the result of a round?
faq.a: Yes. After every round, “Share the result” turns the summary into a picture that you send from your phone’s share menu. Names only appear on it if your group turns them on.

faq.q: Why does my iPhone ask for access to photos?
faq.a: Only when you save a result picture to your photos with “Save Image” in the share menu. The app may then add photos – it cannot read your photos.
Exclusively for adults aged 18 and over. The cards are about flirting, dating and personal questions – text only, no images and no nudity.
